labelShuffledArm_G4.construction: per spacecraft, the multiset of inter-label gaps is permuted and the event times rebuilt from the first real event, seed 20260922 (amendment 3). Permuting labels onto themselves would be the identity for a membership test.

skillLost.reading: gate G4 asks that the permuted arm lose ALL skill. What is published is the fraction of the real recall the permuted arm retains, because that is a number and 'loses all skill' is an impression.

reversalClause.clause: registration 3.1: if any |da| bin reverses sign the POOLED claim is WITHHELD and the reversal is the result. The floor already reversed the 50-100 m bin against the shipped detector, so the clause was live before this ran.

screenE1.screen: the learned model's recall Wilson lower bound must exceed the shipped detector's Wilson upper bound of 9.656% at the matched false-flag rate

labelShuffledIncrement.note: a PAIRED bootstrap over ELEVEN clusters. The interval is the interval of the difference. An increment whose interval straddles zero is NOT DEMONSTRATED, never a trend.

paired.note: a PAIRED bootstrap over ELEVEN clusters. The interval is the interval of the difference. An increment whose interval straddles zero is NOT DEMONSTRATED, never a trend.

E1c.screen: registration 3.2: the full model's recall increment above the cadence-only floor, at the same matched false-flag rate, must have an object-clustered bootstrap lower bound above zero. Failing means the model measures the sampling schedule.

dispersion.screen: registration 3.4: the screen FIRES unless the full model's dispersion is below the cadence-only floor's with a bootstrap lower bound on the difference above zero. A score whose rate is predicted by sampling class is measuring sampling class.

regimeMatchedControl.note: amendment 2 A2.1: the SAME passive class, partition, admissibility rule, hash order and cap, restricted to GEO. The threshold does not move -- it is the one fixed on the registered all-regime null.

screenE3.screen: the routine-keeper flag rate may not exceed the passive null's by more than 3.0; the screen is read on the REGISTERED ratio (amendment 2 A2.1) and the matched ratio is published beside it

t14Comparator.reason: registration 3.4 requires T14's own tail-rank score on the identical populations and threshold. T14 is DESIGN LANDED with no registration and no instrument, so no tail-rank score exists to run. The comparator is UNMEASURED, never a pass, and the learned score is not credited with beating it.

t3CadenceCarriers.reason: registration 3.4 admits the T3 14.00 d inclination-line carriers only WHERE THEIR NORADS ARE RECOVERABLE FROM A COMMITTED ARTIFACT. The committed line artefact carries 8 named top carriers for that line, not the 56 named comsats, and 8 is below gate G7's bar of 20. The population is UNMEASURED, never zero, and lends its name to nothing.

G_geometryProbe.t13SubsetLimitation: the committed v2 ledger is a SUBSET -- every burn another instrument also labelled plus a seeded uniform sample of the rest, 10,326 rows of 3,914,621 -- so which windows carry a type is biased toward windows another instrument also flagged. Stronger than the T14 fallback; still not a gate against a complete typing.

baseline.binKeyNote: the keys are `truthset_recall.bin_of`'s own. A baseline quoted under a different key is compared against nothing, and the reversal clause then reads as silence rather than as a comparison.
baseline.instrument: tools/proximity_plane.detect_manoeuvres, shipped settings, imported and called, never edited

compositionLimits: The labels are ELEVEN GEODETIC AND ALTIMETRY SPACECRAFT, not constellations: CryoSat-2, Sentinel-3A, Sentinel-3B, Jason-1, Jason-2, Jason-3, SWOT, SARAL, HY-2A, TOPEX/Poseidon, Sentinel-6A.
No figure here is 'the model's recall' without the qualifier: on this labelled set, these eleven geodetic and altimetry spacecraft, these burn sizes.
Nothing here says anything about Starlink, about any constellation, or about any operator whose manoeuvre log is not public. A constellation-class labelled baseline remains UNMEASURED.
Eleven cooperative, exceptionally well-tracked spacecraft are not a census. What makes them measurable makes them unrepresentative.
Recall and precision measured on different populations do not compose.
Every threshold here is a chosen screen, not a physical law.

floor.note: every number below is an increment above THIS, with it printed beside, and never an increment above the shipped detector's 7.937%.
